issues.title: Duplicate charge for annual plan
issues.problem_statement: The customer said they were charged twice for their annual plan the previous week and asked for a refund of the second payment.

items.description: Customer reported being charged twice for the annual plan and asked for a refund of the second payment; support said two payments are visible.
evidence: I was charged twice for my annual plan last week.

items.description: Support will raise the duplicate payment with the billing team for review; the billing team will check and get back to the customer.
evidence: I will raise it with our billing team for review.
The billing team will check and get back to you.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Refund request and mention of a bank dispute are sensitive topics that require human review under policy.
